creator: Original native SVG artwork created for TROY in this workspace

troy-citadel.svg.caption_ru: Учебная схема укреплённой цитадели. План и пропорции условны.
troy-citadel.svg.limits: Not an excavation plan, scale drawing, reconstruction of a particular Troy phase, or evidence of exact gate structure. Sloping stone fortification concept; roofs, houses, gate and arrangement are explanatory geometry. No dimensions or historical quotation.

troy-strata.svg.caption_ru: Девять основных периодов: ранние внизу. Равная толщина не означает равную длительность.
troy-strata.svg.limits: Sequential periods I–IX only; subdivisions and ongoing changes in archaeological classification omitted; no measured layer thickness or topology. VI and VII visually emphasized for discussion of Late Bronze Age.
troy-strata.svg.interaction: Each period group has class="phase phase-vi" etc and data-phase="VI". Add class active or data-active="true" on inline SVG group to override highlight. Removing active restores VI/VII amber, others cyan.

troy-icon.svg.limits: No ancient inscription, no exact archaeological gate reconstruction. Key elements lie within central 80% safe zone. Coarse geometry optimized for small icons.

troy-connections.svg.caption_ru: Эгейское море → Дарданеллы → Мраморное море. Троя близ южного входа в пролив.
troy-connections.svg.limits: Schematic relationships only, not a geographical map. Abstract shorelines and positions are not to scale and do not represent Bronze Age coastlines. Passage arrow indicates connection, not a current, shipping monopoly or documented route.

licensing: Original graphics, no external raster assets or font files. May be distributed with the application.
